prompt:
Build 2048 on a 4x4 board drawn on the canvas. start() places two tiles (2 with 90% chance, else 4) on random empty cells. A move slides every tile as far as possible; two equal tiles that meet merge into their sum, each tile merges at most once per move, and merging starts from the side the tiles move toward ([2,2,2,0] left gives [4,2,0,0]). Each merge adds the new value to the score. A move that changes the board increments moves and spawns one tile; a move that changes nothing returns false and spawns nothing. Creating 2048 sets won true and play continues. A full board without possible merges ends the game. Keyboard: arrows/WASD. Touch: swipes of at least 30 px.

Contract (window.Game; implement exactly):
- Game.start(): new game from any phase; phase becomes 'play'
- Game.getState(): {phase:'menu'|'play'|'over', score, won, moves, grid (4 rows of 4 numbers, grid[row][col], row 0 at the top, 0 = empty)}
- Game.setSeed(n): seed the PRNG behind all randomness (applies at the next start())
- Game.step(n): advance exactly n fixed 1/60 s ticks synchronously
- Game.input.move(dir): 'up'|'down'|'left'|'right'; returns true when the board changed
- Game.debug.setGrid(grid): replace the board exactly (no spawn), then check for game over

Acceptance (checked by Kyora Bench browser tests): merge rules in all directions, no-op moves, game over, 2048, seeded spawns, keyboard and swipes.
